name: Metallicdramon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Attacking] ＜De-Digivolve 4＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 4 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[When Digivolving] None of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon can digivolve until the end of their turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave battle area other than by one of your effects, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Rock Dragon] or [Earth Dragon] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
